_: How the farm's beasts idle (animals.gd reads it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). kinds.<kind>.life: the moves a beast of that kind plays one after another, each [move, how often it's picked, [fewest, most] times in a row]; a move is the model's own clip of that name, or one made in derive. derive.<move>: a head-down move made from the idle: from (the base clip), bones (the neck chain and the head, turned evenly), head (the head bone), muzzle (how far past the head bone the nose lies, in neck lengths: the rigs have no nose bone), to (the share of its standing height the muzzle comes down to: 0.1 is nose in the grass), bob ([degrees, seconds]: a slow chew, a pig's rooting, a quick peck), ease (seconds in and out). blend: seconds one move takes to become the next. mostTurn: the most a neck and head are turned in all, degrees (a short-necked rig stops here with its nose as low as it goes: the cow, sheep and war horse don't reach the grass by the neck alone). Goat and chicken have no model in the game yet: their lives wait here for one (its bone names may need setting).
